Let today go.

posts.instagram:
Shoes off. Record on. Let today go.

On the cover of The End of a Bad Day, a couple sinks into the couch together, eyes closed, while a record spins on the turntable beside them and the evening light glows orange over the brick buildings outside. It's chill rap and R&B over lo-fi jazz grooves from Slamdino Entertainment ft. DJ Bombchelle.

Reflective and made to unwind, for the Monday night that ran long.

posts.title: Subscribed for the Morning
posts.feed_hook:
Coffee up. Sun up.
City's already moving.

video_frames.hook:
Coffee up.
Sun up.
City's moving.

posts.instagram:
Coffee up. Sun up. City's already moving.

On the cover of Subscribed for the Morning, a woman with headphones around her neck holds a mug of coffee and looks out over the city as the sun comes up and a train rolls along the elevated tracks, with turntables and a laptop set up in front of her. It's uplifting trap-soul from DJ Bombchelle.

Fresh and made for the morning routine, so queue it up tonight for tomorrow's start.
